title: Object Detection as a Positive-Unlabeled Problem
mechanism: Treats unlabelled regions as unlabelled rather than negative, using a non-negative PU risk with a class prior, so missing annotations stop teaching false negatives.
adaptation: nnPU risk on crack vs background pixels only inside the dark-ridge mask, where missing cracks can hide; standard CE elsewhere. The class prior is set per source from labelled crack density.
min_experiment: Arm: nnPU crack loss, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metrics: relR@2, relP@2, components found. Kill if relR@2 shows no detectable difference or relP@2 drops by more than 0.02.
evidence: R (abstract): a PU loss beats the standard PN loss on PASCAL VOC and COCO across levels of missing labels. Detection, not segmentation.
